title: tooling(objectui-readiness 4): objectui scripts address git paths relative to the repo root — `git show ref:packages/…`, `diff --name-only`, `ls-files`, `ls-tree` break one level down in ui/; prefix via nestedPrefix() (parent #25677, 2d/6)
body:
Filing gate ④: sub-issue 2d/6 of the epic #25677 (`pm:epic`; epic PM `session_01RSDL3SFtJaKzcymvCD8RsU`). Part of #25677. ⛔ Not a claim. Follow-up of #25723 (objectui#13484), measured on the `DO NOT MERGE` verification PR #25718, run 4 (40149547507, head d17ed5edf9).

**Why.** #25723 made objectui's scripts find the workspace root (`pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `turbo.json`) when the tree is `ui/` of the objectstack monorepo. Run 4 shows the second half of the same class: scripts that hand **paths to git**. A path in `git show <ref>:packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`, in `git ls-tree <ref> packages/…`, or matched against `git diff --name-only` / `git ls-files` output is relative to the **git repository root**, not to the script's working directory — so in the merged tree every such path is missing its `ui/` prefix, whatever `cwd` the script runs git with. First casualty: Type Check UI red at `check:i18n-drift`, `cannot read b77bb37eb2…:packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts — is b77bb37eb2 in this clone?` — the ref is objectstack's merge-base and is in the clone; the path is wrong. Everything downstream of that step (`check:i18n-designer-parity`, `type-check:scripts` / `vitest-config` / `e2e`, the `tsc` run over the ui packages) has not run in CI yet. The cutover PR cannot be green until this class is fixed, and like #25723 it is fixed in objectui `main` first so the import carries it.

**Who does it, where it lands:** the epic PM dispatches it (os-dev, objectui checkout). One PR to **objectstack-ai/objectui `main`**; the epic PM re-measures on the verification branch and records the remaining reds on #25697.

## 维护者速读

#25723 让 objectui 的脚本在 `ui/` 子目录里能找到工作区根文件。第四轮验证暴露了同一类问题的另一半：给 **git** 传路径的脚本。`git show ref:packages/…`、`git ls-tree`、以及对 `git diff --name-only` / `git ls-files` 输出做匹配的脚本，路径都是相对 **git 仓库根** 而不是脚本所在目录，所以在合并后的树里全部少了 `ui/` 前缀。第一个倒下的是 `check:i18n-drift`（Type Check UI 在这一步红），后面的 tsc 还没跑到。本卡让这些脚本用 #25723 已经提供的 `nestedPrefix()`（或 git 自身的 `ref:./path`、`--relative`）补前缀，先落 objectui main。不改受管面。

## Measured

| Evidence | Reading |
|---|---|
| #25718 run 4 Type Check UI | lucide `check:icon-record-names` and `check:i18n-keys` green after the verify commit; red at `check:i18n-drift`: `cannot read b77bb37eb2c738c40093acb04f19fa8fc2dd605a:packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` (`scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs:340`). `git cat-file -t b77bb37eb2` in the same clone = `commit` (objectstack's merge-base with `origin/main`), so the ref resolves and the path does not |
| Local, merged tree at d17ed5edf9 | `check:i18n-drift` reproduces exactly; `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `type-check:scripts`, `type-check:vitest-config`, `type-check:e2e` green when run after it |
| Census (`ui/scripts/*.mjs`) | 31 scripts spawn `git show` / `diff` / `ls-files` / `ls-tree` / `log` / `cat-file`; not all of them hand git a path or match root-relative output — the dev triages. Heaviest: `check-changeset-claims.mjs` (11 calls), `check-changeset-presence.mjs` (7), `check-readme-exports.mjs` (6), `check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` (6), `check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs` (5), `check-vi-mock-specifiers.mjs` (5), `markdown-test-inputs.mjs` (4), `select-affected-tests.mjs` (3), `check-test-path-roots.mjs` (3), `check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` (3), `check-lockfile-integrity.mjs` (3), `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` (3) |

## Scope

1. Triage the 31 scripts: for each git call, classify (a) path **into** git (`show ref:path`, `ls-tree ref path`, `diff -- path`, `log -- path`), (b) root-relative path **out of** git (`diff --name-only`, `ls-files`, `ls-tree` output) matched against `packages/…`-shaped literals or globs, (c) no path involved (`rev-parse`, `merge-base`, `cat-file -t`) — (c) needs nothing.
2. Fix (a) and (b) with one idiom, chosen by the dev and written down in `scripts/workspace-root.mjs`'s header: either prefix with `nestedPrefix(root)` (`''` standalone, `'ui/'` merged), or use git's own cwd-relative forms (`ref:./path`, `--relative`, `ls-files` run from the tree) — not a mix per script.
3. Extend `check-ui-root-lookups` (or the gate #25723 taught the walk shape) so a new `git show …:packages/` / `ls-tree … packages/` literal without the prefix helper is refused — the class must not regrow before cutover.
4. Tests: the merged-layout verification #25723 established (scratch copy of the verification worktree) run for every fixed script; `scripts/__tests__` for the touched scripts, the whole suite once (objectui gate chains).

Out of scope: the lucide record-icon list (regenerated, separate class), the dependency-resolution class (#25726), the spec drift (#25727), anything under `.github/**`.

## Verification (the dev's)

- objectui standalone: `pnpm check:i18n-drift`, `pnpm check:changeset-presence`, the other touched gates, `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__` — green, no gate skipped; CI green.
- Merged layout (scratch copy of `/home/claude/objectstack-issue-25697` with the patch applied under `ui/`): `pnpm --dir ui run check:i18n-drift` finds the merge-base pack; every triaged (a)/(b) script runs to its real verdict instead of a path error.
- The epic PM: the same patch as a verify commit on #25718 → run 5; Type Check UI reaches the `tsc` step.

## Done when

- objectui `main` carries the fix with a gate that refuses the regrowth; on the verification branch Type Check UI passes `check:i18n-drift` and the following steps up to `tsc`, whose errors (if any) belong to #25727.

**Size:** M (31 scripts to triage, ~10–15 to touch, one gate extension). **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none. **Blocked-by:** objectui#13484 (#25723) must land first — same files (`scripts/workspace-root.mjs`, `check-ui-root-lookups`) and the same objectui branch.

## 风险

- Shallow CI clones: a few gates fall back to "cannot find merge-base" paths; the fix must keep that fallback and only change the path part (the run-4 clone had the ref).
- Mixed idioms (some scripts `./path`, some `nestedPrefix`) make the regrowth gate hard to write; one idiom.

## Dedupe

Open issues 2026-10-25 01:35Z filtered on `nestedPrefix` / `ls-tree` / `git show` / `check-i18n-en-drift`: #25723 (objectui#13484 in the merge queue) covers file readers only, its body names git paths as a follow-up; nothing else. **New.**
